title: Display welcome message on app open + fix Android Chrome removeChild crash

requirements.text: Display a welcome/informational message dialog when the application first opens (on initial load). The message should be dismissible by the user and should not reappear on subsequent visits within the same session. The message content should be configurable and displayed in a modal or banner at app startup.

quotes: Afficher un message à l'ouverture de l'application

acceptanceCriteria: A dialog or modal appears automatically when the app first loads
The user can dismiss the message with a close/confirm button
The message does not reappear after being dismissed within the same session
The message is displayed in English

requirements.text: Investigate and fix the Android Chrome DOMException 'removeChild' crash shown in the uploaded screenshot. The error occurs when a node being removed is not a child of the target node. Audit all components that perform conditional rendering, portal usage, or dynamic DOM manipulation (particularly dialogs, modals, and tab navigation) and apply defensive guards or use stable keying strategies to prevent this crash on Android Chrome.

quotes: Échec de l'exécution de 'removeChild' sur 'Node' : le nœud à supprimer n'est pas un enfant de ce nœud.

acceptanceCriteria: The app no longer crashes with a DOMException removeChild error on Android Chrome
The ErrorBoundary screen showing 'Quelque chose s'est mal passé' is no longer triggered by this specific error
All dialogs, modals, and navigation components render and unmount without DOM errors on Android Chrome

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
The welcome message feature must not require backend changes
nonGoals: Changing the overall app layout or navigation structure
Persisting the dismissed state across multiple sessions or in the backend
Rewriting the ErrorBoundary component logic beyond fixing the root cause
